snippet.title: One Shot = How Many Dollars? Real US Army Costs
snippet.description:
#USArmy #MilitaryWeapons

Look, in this video we break down the real cost of firing US Army weapons — using official 2025 data. From tanks to rifles, helicopters to rocket launchers — we went through how much each shot actually costs.

We did the math for the M1A2 Abrams, the M4/M4A1 Carbine, the AH-64 Apache, the M2 .50 Cal, the HIMARS, and a bunch of other missiles and munitions.

What you’ll see inside:
- Side-by-side cost comparisons (how much money literally goes out with each shot).

What really drives those numbers: ammo price, vehicle amortization, logistics, maintenance, support.

- On-screen breakdowns and calculations so you can follow exactly how we got the numbers.

Basically, it’s an honest look at what the headlines don’t tell you — how expensive modern firepower really is when you pull the trigger.
